Class Deck<T extends Card>

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.board.Deck<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the specific type of Card contained in this deck
public class Deck<T extends Card> extends Object
Represents a generic deck of cards in the game.

This class manages a collection of cards of a specific type, providing operations to draw a defined number of cards from the top of the deck and to track the remaining cards.

  • Constructor Details

    • Deck

      public Deck(List<T> deck)
      Creates a new Deck initialized with the provided list of cards.

      A defensive copy of the provided list is created to ensure that external modifications do not affect the internal state of the deck.

      Parameters:
      deck - the initial list of cards to populate the deck

  • Method Details

    • drawCards

      public List<T> drawCards(int numCards)
      Draws a specified number of cards from the top of the deck. The drawn cards are subsequently removed from the deck's internal collection.
      Parameters:
      numCards - the exact number of cards to draw
      Returns:
      a list containing the drawn cards
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the requested number is negative or exceeds the total number of currently available cards

    • getRemainingCardIds

      public List<String> getRemainingCardIds()
      Retrieves the unique identifiers of all cards currently remaining in the deck.
      Returns:
      a list of strings representing the IDs of the available cards
